sub_site: small cell lung cancer tissue and paired adjacent normal lung

evidence.quote: 16S rRNA gene sequencing was performed on tumor-adjacent normal lung-paired samples harvested from 53 patients
Variable region 4 (V4) of the 16S rRNA gene was amplified using primers 515FB and 806RB
The amount of bacterial DNA was quantified using the Femto Bacterial DNA Quantification Kit

notes: Microbiome is a minor component of a multi-omics SCLC paper. 53 tumour-normal pairs (106 samples). Only three dominant genera named in text; full profile in Supplementary Fig. 13f (not available). No negative controls or decontamination reported. Authors describe tumour microbiota but draw no explicit conclusion on resident microbiome vs contamination.
